content:
The stairs go down, an impossibly long time it feels like. At the end you see gold.
In a room full of golden walls reflecting the light around you, a hallway continues to a circular end room. An obsidian monolith lies in the center, completely smooth except for the imprint of a hand. Along the wall, 3 Triton skeletons lay. One is covered in a fish scale full plate (full plate, no disadv on stealth and allows swim speed equal to walk) while two others seem to have a crown and tiara. Something seems to poke out behind the monolith. As you approach a voice appears loudly and frightening, as if  a warning.

content:
Leaf stops in front of the Mason door and whispers, looking up at the roses on top of her head she whispers in Elvish, ||Stay with the letter until Archivist Daysong gets it. He's the big blue yeti we talked to yesterday. You can come back once he has it, but if anyone else grabs it wait for them to leave then tell me. Thanks Lilly|| Leaf walks in and leaves a folded piece of paper, along with a rose bush, on a desk then walks to <#636019335231569940>. 

In careful cursive handwriting it reads: 
|| I talked with Ebuc under the tree in the cargo bay. He said he blames himself for for Rah's death, and that he has to get smarter. I'm worried that he's looking for knowledge in the wrong places. He's very close friends with Goanhawe, which is concerning given how much his name has been brought up in regards to the Golden Dawn. I was worried he was working with them, so I begged him to come back. He said he hasn't gone anywhere, and I could tell he meant it. He told me he trusts me, but he has issues with Castor. They used to be close friends, but now Castor seems determined to have conflict with him. Ebuc said he might have an answer to this conflict, but hes still searching. He was telling the truth to this as well. I don't think he lied at all until the very end when he said he didn't want to believe his "theory". Whatever his theory is, he hopes its true. Ebuc said he'd tell me what it is, so I'm hoping to be able to listen to it tomorrow, if not tonight. 
Sincerely,
-Leaf

P.S. I had my rose bush Lilly stay to make sure the letter gets delivered, hope thats ok. ||
